description: Split a monorepo CI pipeline into path-based job scoping with caching and parallelism. Currently a single CI pipeline runs all jobs on every push (lint, test, build for 12 services). Must: configure path-based trigger rules (only run jobs affected by changed files), set up dependency caching (Go modules, npm, pip), parallelize independent service builds, add a merge-gate that aggregates results, and verify that PR builds complete in < 5 minutes. Risk factors: cross-service dependency detection missing, cache invalidation causing stale builds, merge-gate blocking on flaky jobs. Tools available: GitHub Actions, Bazel, Nx, Turborepo, act.
